title: ACE-Align: Attribute Causal Effect Alignment for Cultural Values under Varying Persona Granularities
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the alignment of Large Language Model (LLM) responses with human survey data on various cultural topics. One of these topics is 'Religious Values', which assesses how well the model's opinions match human responses to questions about religion from the World Values Survey and the International Social Survey Programme.
findings: The paper finds that the influence of demographic attributes (e.g., gender, education, residence, marital status) on 'Religious Values' varies significantly across different countries. The proposed ACE-Align method is shown to be more effective at capturing these heterogeneous causal effects compared to baseline models, thus improving the model's cultural alignment on religious topics among others.
